title: Aqueous-Based Cadmium Telluride Quantum Dot/Polyurethane/Polyhedral Oligomeric Silsesquioxane Composites for Color Enhancement in Display Backlights

source_inventory.title: Aqueous-Based Cadmium Telluride Quantum Dot/Polyurethane/Polyhedral Oligomeric Silsesquioxane Composites for Color Enhancement in Display Backlights
source_inventory.scope: All eight eligible main pages: quantified TGA synthesis, separately scoped ligand-growth observations, CdTe/PU and CdTe/POSS/PU film preparation and properties, stability comparisons, actual display configurations and qualified projected gamut.
source_conflicts: Main p.2 Materials names sodium tellurite; the Methods formula is printed NaTeO3. The literal formula is not silently changed to Na2TeO3.
limitations: Matching local SI is known present but screened no_target_recipe without an existing positive resolution; excluded and unread. No global absence claim.
TG/MPA synthesis quantities and growth curves are not imported from excluded SI or cited external methods.
No curve digitization or particle/polymer atom reconstruction. Unresolved exact sample joins remain explicit.
